pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Intro]
(piano instrumental, quiet lingering atmosphere)

[Verse 1]
You said it was love at first
but maybe it was kindness
a gentle light you gave
in a quiet moment

Your shining smile
moved something in me
like warm sunlight
through a silent room

[Pre-Chorus]
Slowly the feeling changed
soft steps turning closer
before I noticed
your heart was beside mine

[Chorus]
We loved
but the air grew thinner
expectations filled the night

The closer I held you
the tighter it felt
and somewhere inside
fear began to grow

[Verse 2]
Your love kept growing
larger than the quiet days
sometimes it carried
shadows of worry

Happiness came and went
like a passing breath
and I slipped away
from the weight of your heart

[Piano Solo]
(expressive emotional piano solo)

[Bridge]
Even the bright days
started losing air
apologies hiding
inside quiet tears

The steps I took for you
led me somewhere else
a place where I could
finally breathe again

[Chorus]
We loved
but couldn't see each other
standing inside our own worlds

Even if I become
the bad one in your story
I'll carry the silence
and slowly disappear

[Outro]
(soft emotional piano outro)

If I was your whole world
where will you look for me

Love tried to keep us
from losing ourselves

Thank you
I loved you

and goodbye
